description: RELACION DE FAROS Y BALIZAS is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Portuaria de Cartagena. The maritime signalling service regulated in this law aims at the installation, maintenance, control and inspection of aids aimed at improving the safety of navigation on the Spanish coastal sea, confirming the position of ships in navigation and facilitating their movements. Coverage: Autoridad Portuaria de Cartagena. The portal shows the English title as "RELATIONSHIP OF FABRICS AND BALIZAS" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autoridad Portuaria de Cartagena. Its keywords include señales, marítimas. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, PDF. The listing shows 2019-02-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://datos.apc.es/wps/portal/open-data/Datos-APC-Condiciones-de-uso). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
